source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Identify any emissions that exceed the permit limits.
3. Accurately record the date and time of the emissions.
4. Quantify the amount of emissions in pounds. 
5. Provide detailed measurements or estimates for all identified emissions.
6. Use this report to demonstrate compliance with the emissions limits.

# Example of the report that might be generated 
| Date | Hour | Identification Number | Pollutant | Amount | Exceeds permit limit | 
|--|--|--|--|--|--| 
| 2023-10-12 | 10 | 123456789 | carbon monoxide|10 lbs |Yes | 
|--|--|--|--|--|--|
| 2023-10-13|11|123456789|VOC
